name: Edge-Radar: Hourly Settlement
description: Settles finished trades against Kalshi, records realized P&L and closing-line value, and keeps the daily-loss gate's view current. Idempotent, places no orders. Hourly at :35. Needs a clone of ai-automation-tools/edge-radar on the machine the task runs on, with its .venv and a .env holding your Kalshi and Odds API keys (python scripts/doctor.py checks both).

parameters.label: Edge-Radar clone
parameters.help: Absolute path to your clone, e.g. C:\Users\you\edge-radar. Its .venv and .env are used.

author: ai-automation-tools
